objective.name: sandbox.py.remote.ops
objective.description: Wrapper Python capability that emits outbound meaning.update, meaning.query, and matter.read toward another context

#root.role: Emit outbound engine calls from the Python wrapper toward another context and return their collected results.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The interpreted wrapper runtime may be started lazily.
effects.outbound_route: The Python wrapper emits outbound meaning.update, meaning.query, and matter.read requests.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local wrapper request becomes a collected set of outbound engine-call results returned from another context.
invariants: sandbox.py.remote.ops must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.py.remote.ops returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.py.remote.ops fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.

subjective.intent: verify outbound wiring from wrapper runtime
